Flow.description: Converts a Quote to an Order using the standard Revenue Cloud createOrderFromQuote invocable action, enabling the Context Mapping Engine for field mapping. Validates Quote.BillToContactId, Bill To Place, and Ship To Place are populated before conversion. Allows user to select or create a Contract, choose activation modes for both Order and Contract, and includes queue routing logic. Custom field mapping is handled via Context Definition configuration in Setup. When creating a new Contract, an AppUsageAssignment record with AppUsageType=RevenueLifecycleManagement is created to enable automatic AssetContractRelationship creation during Order activation. 2026-06-09: Bill To / Ship To carryover moved to the QuoteToOrderFieldMapper Apex action; canvas set to auto-layout.
Flow.label: Fortra Quote to Order Conversion

recordUpdates.description: Clears ContractId on the Quote before createOrderFromQuote to prevent "Order Start Date can't be later than its contract's end date" validation error. The flow handles Contract linking independently after Order creation.
recordUpdates.name: Clear_Quote_ContractId
recordUpdates.label: Clear Quote ContractId

recordUpdates.description: Clears Quote.ValidationResult before createOrderFromQuote. The platform sets ValidationResult to TransactionIncomplete whenever upstream automations touch QuoteLineItems after TLE priced them, and createOrderFromQuote then rejects with the misleading "prices aren't updated" error. Clearing this field here lets the action proceed; if pricing is actually stale, the action will re-set the field and fail naturally.
recordUpdates.name: Clear_Quote_Validation
recordUpdates.label: Clear Quote Validation

fields.name: ChecklistIncomplete_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because the Operations Checklist is not complete. All checklist items must be completed before conversion.


{!Validate_Checklist_Complete.errorMessage}

fields.name: ChecklistIncomplete_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Navigate to the Operations Checklist related list on the Quote or Opportunity
  3. Complete all outstanding checklist items
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: ContractDateError_Header
fields.fieldText:
Contract Start Date Conflict


The selected Contract cannot be linked to this Order because the Quote Start Date is earlier than the Contract Start Date.


The Order Start Date (Effective Date) must be on or after the Contract Start Date.

fields.name: ContractDateError_Details
fields.fieldText:
Date Details

Quote Start Date:{!varQuoteRecord.StartDate}
Contract Start Date:{!varSelectedContractRecord.StartDate}

fields.name: ContractDateError_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Back to Contract Selection and choose a different Contract with an earlier Start Date
  2. Or select Create a new Contract instead to generate a new Contract matching the Quote dates
  3. Or click Close to cancel the conversion and update the Quote Start Date first

fields.name: BillingError_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because the Bill To Place is not selected.


The Bill To Place is required to create the Order and associated billing records.

fields.name: BillingError_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Edit the Quote and select a Bill To Place
  3. Save the Quote
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: BillingStreetError_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because the Billing Address is not fully populated.


A Bill To Place is selected, but the address fields (Street, City, State, etc.) have not been copied to the Quote. This is required for Order activation.

fields.name: BillingStreetError_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Verify the Bill To Place record has a complete address
  3. Ensure the Quote's Billing Street, City, State, and Country fields are populated
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: Error_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because the Bill To Contact field is not populated.


The Bill To Contact is required to create the Order and associated billing records.

fields.name: Error_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Edit the Quote and populate the Bill To Contact field
  3. Save the Quote
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: ShippingError_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because the Ship To Place is not selected.


The Ship To Place is required to create the Order and associated fulfillment records.

fields.name: ShippingError_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Edit the Quote and select a Ship To Place
  3. Save the Quote
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: NotSyncing_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because it is not the syncing Quote for the Opportunity.


Only the syncing Quote can be converted to an Order. The syncing Quote is the one currently linked to the Opportunity.

fields.name: NotSyncing_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Navigate to the Opportunity related to this Quote
  3. Use the Start Sync action on this Quote to make it the syncing Quote
  4. Run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: OrderExists_Header

An Order already exists for this Quote. The Quote cannot be converted again until the existing Order is removed.

Existing Order


Order Number: {!varExistingOrderRecord.OrderNumber}

Status: {!varExistingOrderRecord.Status}

fields.name: OrderExists_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Navigate to the existing Order: {!varExistingOrderRecord.OrderNumber}
  2. If the Order is Active: click Deactivate to deactivate it first
  3. Delete the Order
  4. Return to this Quote and run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: OrderFailed_Header
fields.fieldText:
Order Creation Failed


An error occurred while converting this Quote to an Order.


Error Details

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

fields.name: OrderFailed_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
Common Causes and Resolutions


Prices not updated: Navigate to the Lines tab → Click Reprice All in the Transaction Line Editor → Wait for repricing to complete → Try again


Configuration warnings: Open the Transaction Line Editor → Resolve any remaining configuration warnings → Try again


Checklist incomplete: Navigate to the Quote → Complete all Operations Checklist items → Try again


Other errors: Contact your Salesforce administrator with the error details above

fields.name: PowerSplitTooLarge_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


{!SplitPowerOrderLines.errorMessage}

fields.name: PowerSplitTooLarge_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
What to do

High Power quantities usually represent seat or site licenses and should be kept on a single order line rather than split into one line per unit. Please contact your Salesforce administrator to review this quote.

fields.name: PricingError_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


Quote lines require repricing before this Quote can be converted to an Order.


Current Pricing Status: {!varQuoteRecord.CalculationStatus}

fields.name: PricingError_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Navigate to the Lines tab
  3. Open the Transaction Line Editor
  4. Click Reprice All
  5. Wait for repricing to complete
  6. Save the changes
  7. Return here and run the Convert to Order action again

fields.name: NotAccepted_Header
fields.fieldText:
Unable to Convert Quote


This Quote cannot be converted to an Order because its status is {!varQuoteRecord.Status}. The Quote must be in Accepted status before it can be converted.

fields.name: NotAccepted_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
To resolve this issue:

  1. Click Close to return to the Quote record
  2. Update the Quote status to Accepted
  3. Run the Convert to Order action again
